products.name: Arch of Serenity 3D Painting

Neutral warm tones: Ivory (#F8F1E6), Sand Beige (#E6D5C1), and Chocolate Brown (#4B2E1E)

Ready to hang with heavy-duty brass wall brackets

Champagne gold dust subtle shimmer accents along crests
Custom framing options in natural oak or raw walnut

Hand-applied 24k champagne gold foil accents
Sturdy heavy-duty linen substrate with zero warp guarantee

Includes hanging guide and brass hardware

Gradient thread palette from ecru and warm taupe to chocolate brown
Anti-reflective museum glass front included

reviews.author: Priya Sundaram
reviews.title: Transformed our entire living room aesthetic!
reviews.comment: The Arch of Serenity 3D painting is beyond breathtaking in person. The tactile texture and warm neutral tones catch the afternoon sun in the most magical way. You can feel the artisan care in every groove.

reviews.author: Rohan Mehta
reviews.title: True luxury craftsmanship
reviews.comment: As an interior architect, I am exceedingly discerning about wall art. TINTOZA delivers gallery-grade craftsmanship with sublime color harmony. The packaging in wooden crates was immaculate.

reviews.author: Ananya Sharma
reviews.title: The thread art is a masterpiece
reviews.comment: The Aura Geometric thread piece is a true conversation starter whenever guests visit. The precision and delicacy are astounding. "Art that makes a space feel home" is truly the perfect tagline.
